g.text: Zero-Copy Shared DRAM (LOCAL_SIZE = 0) • Autonomous On-Chip GPU Command Processor • Platform Bus
32-bit GPU Virtual Addressing • Host maps shared ring & PSOs • GPU CP traverses page tables autonomously without OS pinning
Shared Physical Memory (Unified System DRAM: LOCAL_SIZE = 0)
Single Physical Pool: Host CPU and GPU Engines read/write zero-copy data structures directly
• Host app writes packets into DRAM
• GPU CP fetches via DMA/AXI master
• Direct HW TU / VF descriptor fetch
• GPU CP walks page tables directly
